143.1.text: After forced I'm, Set R median prompt-only P(' sorry') is at least 10 times plain.

143.2.text: After forced I'm, Set R median answer-only P(' sorry') is at least 10 times plain.

143.3.text: After forced I, Set R median answer-only P('m') is below prompt-only.
